in_sanskrit.name: अनोज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Anoj is derived from the Sanskrit word अनोज (anoj), which means 'not like', 'unlike', or 'different'. It is often used as a name for a child who is unique or one-of-a-kind.

in_hindi.name: अनोज
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Anoj in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word अनोज (anoj), which means 'not like', 'unlike', or 'different'. In Hindi, it is often translated as अलावाचिन (alavachin), which means 'one who is different' or 'unique'.

in_tamil.name: அநோஜ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Anoj in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word अनोज (anoj), which means 'not like', 'unlike', or 'different'. In Tamil, it is often translated as அல்லவால் (allavāl), which means 'one who is different' or 'unique'.

in_telugu.name: అనోజ్
